title: Lila & Eve
description:
S1 E1
Lila, a grief-stricken mother reeling from her son's murder, attends a support group where she meets Eve, who urges her to take matters into her own hands to track down her son's killers. They soon embark on a journey of revenge, but also recovery.

title: Juice
description:
S1 E1
Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

title: Double Play
description:
S1 E1
In a high-stakes game of dominoes, the players confront their lust, desperation, rage, and remorse with deadly consequences.

title: Paid in Full
description:
S1 E1
A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience.  Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

title: Four Brothers
description:
S1 E1
After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

title: Baby Boy
description:
S1 E1
Jody is a 20-year-old African American in South Central L.A. who is trying to live large but doesn't have a job. Growing up is tough on Jody, but a series of events force him to learn lessons about living, loving and surviving as a man in the hood.

title: Ride to Freedom: The Rosa Parks Story
description:
S1 E1
Rosa Parks recalls events leading to her act of peaceful defiance against racial bus segregation and inspiring the 1955 Montgomery Bus Boycott.
